name: Light
description:
Light is the finance platform for your company's spend, bills, cards, and accounting. This connector lets Claude work with your Light data on your behalf, scoped to your account and your permissions.

Once connected, you can ask Claude to:
- Search bills and vendors and manage payables
- Look up cards and card transactions and edit draft transactions
- Draft expenses and submit them for reimbursement
- Search the chart of accounts and tax codes
- Find team members and see pending approvals
- Answer questions from your company policy and Light help articles
- Run and edit financial reports scoped to your company

_published_faq.name: How do I add Light to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Light to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api.light.inc/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Light MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Light lists 42 MCP tools, including approve_task, attach_card_transaction_receipt, attach_files, create_support_ticket, delete_system_skill, delete_user_skill, get_batch_operation_status, get_bill_details, get_card_details, get_card_transaction_details, get_draft_expenses, and get_help_articles.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Light?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Light in financial-services on the Manufact MCP catalog include Contract-Factory — Sociétés & SIREN, Kavara Kirk, CeylonCharts, Netzo, and Ramp Data.
Light requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Light is developed by Light. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
